Norton 1703, Light Commercial Door Closer

The Norton 1703 Light Duty Commercial Door Closer comes tri-packed. This aluminum store front door overhead concealed closer is a light #3 spring closer. It has a 8 inch x 3/4 inch hole pattern.

Non-handed and have individual adjustments for sweep speed, latch speed, and backcheck cushioning. They are tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm installations.

Features and Specifications of the Norton 1703 Series Closer:

  • Finish: Aluminum
  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable back check
  • Spring Tension: #3
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 8"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 3/4"
  • Closer Body Length: 8-5/8"
  • Closer Body Height: 2-1/16"
  • Closer Body Projection: 2-1/16"
  • Tri-packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm mounting
  • Non Handed
  • Aluminum alloy shell
  • Rack & pinion operation
  • UL 10C Compliant
  • Grade 2 Certified

Sold Individually
